introduction: The audit storage ingestion subsystem provides a DuckDB-backed storage engine and REST API endpoints for ingesting structured telemetry produced by nightshift agents running afaudit. Note: requirements referencing afaudit APIs are based on PRD descriptions and should be cross-checked against the installed afaudit package before implementation.

glossary.AF_AUDIT_DB_PATH: Environment variable that overrides the default DuckDB audit database file path; defaults to `<data_dir>/audit.duckdb` derived from the hub's SQLite database directory.
glossary.ActorType: Field on HubEvent indicating the credential type of the actor; one of: admin_token, api_key, pat, system.
glossary.CGO_ENABLED: Go build environment variable that must be set to 1 to enable CGo, required for the duckdb-go driver.
glossary.Emitter: Go interface in the internal/audit package with a single Emit method for writing hub-internal audit events.
glossary.HubEvent: Go struct representing a hub-internal audit event passed to the Emitter interface.
glossary.INSERT OR IGNORE: DuckDB SQL statement variant that silently skips insertion when a record with the same primary key already exists, used for idempotent ingestion.
glossary.JSONL: JSON Lines format — newline-delimited JSON records used by afaudit for local telemetry file storage.
glossary.Retry-After: HTTP response header returned with 503 responses indicating the number of seconds the client should wait before retrying.
glossary.Store: The audit.Store interface in internal/audit/store.go, defining Insert(ctx, HubEvent) error and query methods. The concrete implementation is audit.store (unexported struct). Spec 18 accepts an audit.Store interface, not the concrete type.
glossary.afaudit: The agent-side audit library that produces structured telemetry (audit events, session outcomes, tool calls, tool errors, trace events) serialized as JSONL files.
glossary.agent_audit_events: DuckDB table storing afaudit AuditEvent records submitted by agents.
glossary.agent_sessions: DuckDB table storing hub-managed agent session lifecycle records; schema defined in this spec, populated by spec 19.
glossary.agent_traces: DuckDB table storing AgentTraceSink trace event records submitted by agents.
glossary.apikit: Internal library providing auth middleware, WriteAPIError, NowUTC, FormatUTC, and GetAuthInfo used across the hub.
glossary.audit.InitSchema: Go function in the internal/audit package that creates all nine audit tables and runs column migrations in a single transaction.
glossary.audit.NewEmitter: Go constructor that creates the default Emitter implementation backed by the Store.
glossary.audit.NewStore: Go constructor that creates a Store wrapping a *sql.DB DuckDB connection.
glossary.audit.OpenDB: Go function in the internal/audit package that calls os.MkdirAll on the parent directory and opens a DuckDB connection.
glossary.audit.RegisterRoutes: Go function that registers all audit ingestion and query HTTP routes on an Echo route group.
glossary.audit.duckdb: The DuckDB database file used by the audit subsystem, stored alongside the hub's SQLite database.
glossary.audit:read: PAT permission scope granting read access to audit events, traces, postmortems, and tool call/error records.
glossary.audit:write: PAT permission scope granting write access to submit audit events, traces, postmortems, and tool call/error records.
glossary.blocked_tasks: Optional JSON array in a postmortem request body containing objects with node_id and reason fields.
glossary.config.toml: Hub configuration file containing the database.path field used to resolve the data directory.
glossary.cost_summary: Required sub-object in a postmortem request body containing aggregated token and cost totals.
glossary.cursor: Opaque base64url-encoded (RFC 4648 §5, no padding) pagination token encoding a JSON object with ts (RFC3339Nano timestamp) and id (UUID) fields, used to retrieve the next page of results.
glossary.data_dir: The directory containing the hub's SQLite database file, resolved from the `database.path` field in config.toml.
glossary.defaultSeverityFor: Go function in internal/audit/severity.go that maps an event_type string to its default severity value.
glossary.event_to_json: afaudit serializer function that produces the JSON shape accepted by the hub's audit ingestion endpoints.
glossary.extraPerms: Slice of apikit.Permission values collected in cmd/af-hub/main.go and registered with the auth system.
glossary.duckdb-go: The github.com/duckdb/duckdb-go package providing an official DuckDB-maintained, CGo-based database/sql-compatible DuckDB driver.
glossary.has_more: Boolean field in paginated GET response envelopes indicating whether additional records exist beyond the current page.
glossary.hub_audit_events: DuckDB table storing hub-internal audit events; schema defined in this spec, populated by spec 18.
glossary.ingested_at: Timestamp column present in all audit tables recording when the hub received and stored the record.
glossary.next_cursor: JSON field in paginated GET response envelopes containing the opaque base64-encoded cursor for the next page, or null if no more pages exist.
glossary.postmortem_not_found: apikit error type returned as HTTP 404 when no postmortem exists for the given run_id.
glossary.postmortems: DuckDB table storing pre-computed postmortem reports keyed by run_id.
glossary.run_id: Identifier for an agent run, formatted as YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_6hexchars (e.g. 20260704_143022_a1b2c3), used as a URL path parameter and foreign key across all audit tables.
glossary.run_status: Field on a postmortem record indicating the terminal state of the run; one of: stalled, block_limit, cost_limit, session_limit.
glossary.schema_version: Integer field on postmortem records indicating the postmortem schema version; only value 1 is accepted.
glossary.session_history: Optional opaque JSON array in a postmortem request body stored as-is without field-level validation.
glossary.session_outcomes: DuckDB table storing afaudit SessionOutcome records submitted by agents.
glossary.sessions:read: PAT permission scope granting read access to agent sessions, token usage, and cost summaries.
glossary.sessions:write: PAT permission scope granting write access to create/close agent sessions and report token usage.
glossary.task_summary: Required sub-object in a postmortem request body containing integer counts of tasks by status.
glossary.token_usage: DuckDB table storing per-session token usage records; schema defined in this spec, populated by spec 19.
glossary.tool_calls: DuckDB table storing afaudit ToolCall records submitted by agents.
glossary.tool_errors: DuckDB table storing afaudit ToolError records submitted by agents.
glossary.unknown_schema_version: apikit error type returned as HTTP 422 when a postmortem submission contains an unsupported schema_version value.
glossary.workspace_access_denied: Error condition returned as HTTP 403 when a generic token's owner does not have write access to the target workspace.
glossary.workspace_archived: Error condition returned as HTTP 409 when an agent attempts to ingest data into a workspace that has been archived.
glossary.workspace_mismatch: Error condition returned as HTTP 403 when a workspace-scoped token's workspace does not match the URL :slug parameter.
glossary.^\\d{8}_\\d{6}_[0-9a-f]{6}$: Regular expression pattern for validating run_id format: YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_6hexchars (e.g. 20260704_143022_a1b2c3)
glossary.QueryParams: Go struct defined in internal/audit/types.go used by all Store query methods: type QueryParams struct { Since *time.Time; Until *time.Time; Order string; Cursor string; Limit int; EventType string; Severity string; NodeID string; SessionID string; ToolName string; Status string }. Each query method uses only the relevant subset of fields.

user_story.goal: have the hub open a DuckDB connection at startup with automatic parent directory creation
user_story.benefit: audit data is persisted durably without manual directory setup

acceptance_criteria.action: call os.MkdirAll on the parent directory of path, then open a DuckDB connection using the duckdb-go driver with path as the DSN
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns (*sql.DB, nil) on success
acceptance_criteria.trigger: the hub calls audit.OpenDB(path) at startup

acceptance_criteria.action: use the value of AF_AUDIT_DB_PATH as the DuckDB file path, ignoring the data_dir default
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: DuckDB connection opens against the explicitly configured path
acceptance_criteria.trigger: AF_AUDIT_DB_PATH is set in the environment

acceptance_criteria.action: resolve the DuckDB path as <data_dir>/audit.duckdb where data_dir is the directory containing the SQLite database file from database.path in config.toml
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: DuckDB connection opens against the resolved default path
acceptance_criteria.trigger: AF_AUDIT_DB_PATH is not set

acceptance_criteria.action: register a deferred close of the DuckDB connection to execute on hub shutdown
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: DuckDB connection is closed cleanly when the hub process exits
acceptance_criteria.trigger: the hub successfully opens the DuckDB connection

acceptance_criteria.action: log the error via slog at error level and abort startup via os.Exit(1) or equivalent — do not continue with a nil audit Store
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: hub process exits with a non-zero exit code; the error message is logged
acceptance_criteria.trigger: audit.OpenDB returns an error

acceptance_criteria.action: call the audit emitter Shutdown() method, blocking until the internal event channel is drained or a 5-second timeout elapses, before the hub process exits
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: in-flight audit events are flushed before exit; no events are silently dropped on graceful shutdown
acceptance_criteria.trigger: the hub receives SIGTERM or SIGINT

edge_cases.action: return an error from audit.OpenDB without opening any DuckDB connection
edge_cases.return_contract: returns (nil, error); hub startup aborts with the error logged
edge_cases.error_condition: os.MkdirAll fails due to a permission error on the parent directory

edge_cases.action: return the driver error from the open call without retrying
edge_cases.return_contract: returns (nil, error); hub startup aborts with the error logged
edge_cases.error_condition: the DuckDB file is locked by another process

edge_cases.action: return an error indicating the path is invalid before calling os.MkdirAll
edge_cases.return_contract: returns (nil, error) with a descriptive message
edge_cases.error_condition: the resolved path is an empty string

user_story.goal: have all audit tables created automatically on startup with non-destructive migrations
user_story.benefit: upgrading the hub binary against an existing audit.duckdb requires no manual intervention

acceptance_criteria.action: execute all nine CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS statements in a single transaction: agent_audit_events, hub_audit_events, session_outcomes, tool_calls, tool_errors, agent_traces, postmortems, agent_sessions, token_usage
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns nil on success; all nine tables exist in the DuckDB file
acceptance_criteria.trigger: the hub calls audit.InitSchema(db) at startup

acceptance_criteria.action: execute ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS statements for any columns added in schema versions newer than the initial release, then commit the transaction
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns nil; existing tables are not dropped or truncated; new columns are added non-destructively
acceptance_criteria.trigger: the DuckDB file already contains tables from a previous hub version

acceptance_criteria.action: run all CREATE TABLE and ALTER TABLE statements within a single database transaction so that partial schema initialization is never committed
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: either all DDL statements succeed and are committed, or none are committed and an error is returned

edge_cases.action: roll back the transaction and return the error
edge_cases.return_contract: returns non-nil error; hub startup aborts
edge_cases.error_condition: a CREATE TABLE statement fails due to a corrupted DuckDB file

edge_cases.action: return the error immediately without executing any DDL
edge_cases.return_contract: returns non-nil error; hub startup aborts
edge_cases.error_condition: the database transaction cannot be opened (e.g., disk full)

user_story.goal: grant agents least-privilege access to audit ingestion endpoints via PAT scopes
user_story.benefit: agents can submit telemetry without holding broad API key access

acceptance_criteria.action: define four PAT permission scopes: audit:read, audit:write, sessions:read, sessions:write, and return them from audit.Permissions() as a slice of apikit.Permission values
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: audit.Permissions() returns a slice of exactly four apikit.Permission entries

acceptance_criteria.action: collect the result of audit.Permissions() into extraPerms so all four audit scopes are registered with the auth system
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: all four scopes are available for PAT grant assignment
acceptance_criteria.trigger: the hub initializes its permission registry

edge_cases.action: reject the request with an insufficient scope error
edge_cases.return_contract: returns HTTP 403 with apikit error body
edge_cases.error_condition: a PAT is presented that lacks the audit:write scope for a write endpoint

edge_cases.action: reject the request with an insufficient scope error
edge_cases.return_contract: returns HTTP 403 with apikit error body
edge_cases.error_condition: a PAT is presented that lacks the audit:read scope for a read endpoint

edge_cases.return_contract: returns HTTP 401 with apikit error body
edge_cases.error_condition: no authentication credential is presented

user_story.goal: emit hub-internal audit events through a stable interface without coupling to the storage layer
user_story.benefit: downstream specs can emit events without depending on Store internals

acceptance_criteria.action: define the Emitter interface with a single method Emit(ctx context.Context, event HubEvent) error, and define the HubEvent struct with fields EventType, ActorID, ActorType, ResourceType, ResourceID, Action, Workspace, and Metadata map[string]any
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: Emitter and HubEvent are exported from the internal/audit package

acceptance_criteria.action: generate a UUID for the event id, set ingested_at to the current UTC time via apikit.NowUTC(), and insert the event into hub_audit_events via the Store
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns nil on successful insertion
acceptance_criteria.trigger: Emit is called with a HubEvent

acceptance_criteria.action: log the error via slog at error level and return nil to the caller — audit emission must never cause a handler to return an error to the client
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns nil regardless of storage failure; error is logged only
acceptance_criteria.error_condition: the Store insert into hub_audit_events fails

acceptance_criteria.action: accept only the values admin_token, api_key, pat, and system for ActorType; these correspond to apikit AuthInfo.CredentialType values and are enforced by convention at emission points, not at ingestion time
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: no runtime validation error is raised at ingestion; enforcement is at the emission call site

edge_cases.action: replace the nil context with context.Background() and log a warning via slog — do NOT return an error; callers must not observe a nil-context as a failure
edge_cases.return_contract: returns nil; the event is emitted using context.Background(); no error is returned to the caller
edge_cases.error_condition: Emit is called with a nil context

edge_cases.action: attempt JSON marshaling; if marshaling fails, log the error and store an empty JSON object in the metadata column
edge_cases.return_contract: returns nil; the event row is stored with metadata set to {}
edge_cases.error_condition: Metadata contains non-JSON-serializable values

user_story.goal: receive clear errors when submitting data with an incorrectly formatted run_id
user_story.benefit: misconfigured agents are caught early rather than silently storing invalid data

acceptance_criteria.action: validate run_id against the regexp `^\d{8}_\d{6}_[0-9a-f]{6}$` (eight decimal digits, underscore, six decimal digits, underscore, six lowercase hex characters); uppercase hex characters are not accepted
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: validation function returns true for valid run_id strings, false for invalid ones

acceptance_criteria.action: reject the request before any body parsing
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns HTTP 400 with apikit error body describing the invalid run_id format
acceptance_criteria.error_condition: the run_id URL path parameter does not match the regexp `^\d{8}_\d{6}_[0-9a-f]{6}$`

acceptance_criteria.action: reject the request
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns HTTP 400 with apikit error body describing the run_id mismatch
acceptance_criteria.error_condition: the request body contains a run_id field that does not match the run_id in the URL path

edge_cases.return_contract: returns HTTP 400 with apikit error body
edge_cases.error_condition: run_id contains uppercase hex characters in the suffix (e.g. A1B2C3)

edge_cases.return_contract: returns HTTP 400 with apikit error body
edge_cases.error_condition: run_id is an empty string

edge_cases.action: accept the request using the URL path run_id as the authoritative value
edge_cases.return_contract: request proceeds normally; run_id from URL path is stored
edge_cases.error_condition: run_id has the correct format but the body run_id field is absent

user_story.goal: submit a single audit event to the hub in the exact JSON format produced by afaudit
user_story.benefit: agent telemetry is stored durably without requiring changes to the afaudit data model

acceptance_criteria.action: validate run_id, apply field defaults (generate UUID for id if absent, set timestamp to apikit.NowUTC() if absent, apply defaultSeverityFor if severity absent), set ingested_at to apikit.NowUTC(), and insert the record into agent_audit_events via INSERT OR IGNORE
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns HTTP 201 with JSON body {id: string, run_id: string, event_type: string, severity: string, created_at: string}
acceptance_criteria.trigger: an authenticated agent submits a POST request with a valid audit event JSON body

acceptance_criteria.action: skip the insert via INSERT OR IGNORE and return the same acknowledgement shape as the original 201 response
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns HTTP 200 with JSON body {id: string, run_id: string, event_type: string, severity: string, created_at: string}
acceptance_criteria.trigger: an agent submits an event with an id that already exists in agent_audit_events

acceptance_criteria.action: accept and store the event, log a warning via slog
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns HTTP 201 with the standard acknowledgement body
acceptance_criteria.trigger: an agent submits an event with an unknown event_type

acceptance_criteria.action: accept only the values info, warning, error, and critical as severity; reject any other non-empty severity value
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: invalid severity returns HTTP 400 with apikit error body

edge_cases.return_contract: returns HTTP 400 with apikit error body citing missing required field: event_type
edge_cases.error_condition: event_type field is missing from the request body

edge_cases.return_contract: returns HTTP 400 with apikit error body citing invalid payload
edge_cases.error_condition: payload field is present but is not a JSON object

edge_cases.action: return a 500 error; no partial data is committed
edge_cases.return_contract: returns HTTP 500 with apikit error body
edge_cases.error_condition: DuckDB write fails (e.g., disk full)

edge_cases.action: return a 503 error with a Retry-After header set to 5
edge_cases.return_contract: returns HTTP 503 with Retry-After: 5 header and apikit error body
edge_cases.error_condition: DuckDB write times out under sustained write contention

edge_cases.return_contract: returns HTTP 400 with apikit error body
edge_cases.error_condition: the id field is present but does not match the standard UUID format (8-4-4-4-12 hex digits with dashes)

user_story.goal: upload existing JSONL audit event files in bulk to the hub
user_story.benefit: historical telemetry from local files is ingested efficiently in a single request

acceptance_criteria.action: pre-validate all items, collect invalid items into the errors array, then insert all valid items in a single DuckDB transaction using INSERT OR IGNORE; count duplicates separately
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns HTTP 200 with JSON body {accepted: integer, duplicates: integer, errors: [{index: integer, id: string, message: string}]}
acceptance_criteria.trigger: an authenticated agent submits a batch of up to 1000 audit events

acceptance_criteria.action: insert only the valid items; include invalid items in the errors array with their zero-based index and reason; do not abort the entire batch
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns HTTP 200 with accepted count reflecting only successfully inserted items, errors array non-empty
acceptance_criteria.trigger: the batch contains some invalid items and some valid items

acceptance_criteria.action: reject the entire request without processing any items
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns HTTP 413 with apikit error body
acceptance_criteria.error_condition: the batch array contains more than 1000 items

acceptance_criteria.action: reject the request
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns HTTP 400 with apikit error body

edge_cases.action: roll back the entire transaction; no valid items are partially committed
edge_cases.return_contract: returns HTTP 500 with apikit error body; accepted count is 0
edge_cases.error_condition: the DuckDB transaction fails after pre-validation (e.g., disk full during write)

edge_cases.action: complete normally; duplicates count equals 1000, accepted equals 0
edge_cases.return_contract: returns HTTP 200 with {accepted: 0, duplicates: 1000, errors: []}
edge_cases.error_condition: all 1000 items in the batch are duplicates

edge_cases.action: return errors for all items; no transaction is opened
edge_cases.return_contract: returns HTTP 200 with {accepted: 0, duplicates: 0, errors: [all items listed]}
edge_cases.error_condition: all items in the batch fail pre-validation

edge_cases.action: Echo rejects the request before the handler is invoked
edge_cases.return_contract: returns HTTP 413 from Echo middleware before handler executes
edge_cases.error_condition: the request body exceeds Echo's 4 MB body size limit

user_story.goal: record the outcome of an agent session including status, duration, and token usage
user_story.benefit: session-level telemetry is available for analysis and postmortem generation

acceptance_criteria.action: validate run_id, generate UUID for id if absent, set ingested_at to apikit.NowUTC(), and insert the record into session_outcomes via INSERT OR IGNORE
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns HTTP 201 with JSON body {id: string, run_id: string, node_id: string, status: string, created_at: string}
acceptance_criteria.trigger: an authenticated agent submits a session outcome with required fields run_id, session_id, status, and timestamp

acceptance_criteria.action: skip the insert via INSERT OR IGNORE
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns HTTP 200 with the same acknowledgement shape as the original 201 response
acceptance_criteria.trigger: an agent submits a session outcome with an id that already exists in session_outcomes

edge_cases.return_contract: returns HTTP 400 with apikit error body citing missing required field: session_id
edge_cases.error_condition: session_id field is missing from the request body

edge_cases.return_contract: returns HTTP 400 with apikit error body citing missing required field: status
edge_cases.error_condition: status field is missing from the request body

edge_cases.return_contract: returns HTTP 500 with apikit error body
edge_cases.error_condition: DuckDB write fails

acceptance_criteria.action: skip the insert via INSERT OR IGNORE

acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns HTTP 201 with JSON body {id: string, run_id: string, tool_name: string, failed_at: string}

acceptance_criteria.action: skip the insert via INSERT OR IGNORE

acceptance_criteria.action: validate run_id, validate run_status is one of stalled/block_limit/cost_limit/session_limit, validate task_summary and cost_summary sub-schemas, set ingested_at to apikit.NowUTC(), and insert into postmortems using run_id as the primary key via INSERT OR IGNORE
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns HTTP 201 with JSON body {run_id: string, run_status: string, created_at: string}
acceptance_criteria.trigger: an authenticated agent submits a postmortem with required fields run_status, started_at, completed_at, task_summary, and cost_summary

acceptance_criteria.action: skip the insert via INSERT OR IGNORE; do not modify the stored record
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns HTTP 200 with the same acknowledgement shape as the original 201 response
acceptance_criteria.trigger: a postmortem for the given run_id already exists in postmortems

acceptance_criteria.action: reject the request
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns HTTP 422 with apikit error body of type unknown_schema_version

correctness_properties.title: Idempotent ingestion via INSERT OR IGNORE
correctness_properties.for_any: audit record submitted with an id that already exists in the target table
correctness_properties.invariant: the stored record is unchanged and the response shape is identical to the original successful ingestion response

correctness_properties.title: run_id format invariant
correctness_properties.for_any: request to any audit ingestion or query endpoint
correctness_properties.invariant: the run_id URL path parameter is validated against the regexp `^\d{8}_\d{6}_[0-9a-f]{6}$` before any database operation is performed; requests with non-matching run_id values never reach the Store

correctness_properties.title: Batch atomicity
correctness_properties.for_any: batch ingestion request containing N valid items
correctness_properties.invariant: either all N valid items are committed to the database or none are; no partial commit occurs within the transaction

correctness_properties.title: Workspace attribution completeness
correctness_properties.for_any: record stored in any audit table via an ingestion endpoint
correctness_properties.invariant: the workspace_slug column equals the :slug URL path parameter of the request that created the record

correctness_properties.title: Cursor pagination stability
correctness_properties.for_any: sequence of paginated GET requests with the same filter parameters and order
correctness_properties.invariant: the union of all returned records across pages equals the full result set with no duplicates and no omissions, regardless of concurrent inserts during pagination

correctness_properties.title: Emit never fails a handler
correctness_properties.for_any: call to the default Emitter.Emit method
correctness_properties.invariant: Emit always returns nil to the caller regardless of whether the underlying Store insert succeeds or fails; storage failures are logged but not propagated

correctness_properties.title: Schema initialization idempotency
correctness_properties.for_any: call to audit.InitSchema on a database that already contains all nine tables
correctness_properties.invariant: InitSchema completes without error and does not drop, truncate, or modify any existing data

correctness_properties.title: Batch pre-validation prevents silent data loss
correctness_properties.for_any: batch containing a mix of valid and invalid items
correctness_properties.invariant: every invalid item appears in the errors array with its zero-based index; no invalid item is silently dropped or inserted

correctness_properties.title: Default severity correctness
correctness_properties.for_any: audit event submitted without a severity field
correctness_properties.invariant: the stored severity equals the output of defaultSeverityFor(event_type) and is one of the four valid values: info, warning, error, critical

correctness_properties.title: Trace event_type closed set enforcement
correctness_properties.for_any: POST request to the traces ingestion endpoint
correctness_properties.invariant: only records with event_type in {session.init, assistant.message, tool.use, tool.error, session.result} are stored; all other event_type values are rejected before any database operation

steps.action: sends POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/runs/:run_id/events with a JSON body matching the afaudit event_to_json format
routes the request to the audit events handler after applying auth middleware
validates the credential (PAT with audit:write scope or API key) and resolves workspace access
validates run_id format against the regexp, checks body/URL run_id consistency, applies field defaults (id, timestamp, severity via defaultSeverityFor), sets ingested_at
executes INSERT OR IGNORE into agent_audit_events with all field values
returns HTTP 201 with acknowledgement body {id, run_id, event_type, severity, created_at} or HTTP 200 if duplicate

execution_paths.title: Agent bulk-uploads JSONL event file via batch endpoint

steps.action: sends POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/runs/:run_id/events/batch with a JSON array of up to 1000 audit events
routes the request to the batch events handler after applying auth middleware
validates the credential and resolves workspace access
checks array length (rejects with HTTP 413 if > 1000, HTTP 400 if empty)
pre-validates all items, collecting invalid items into the errors array; valid items proceed
opens a single DuckDB transaction and executes INSERT OR IGNORE for each valid item; counts duplicates; commits the transaction
returns HTTP 200 with {accepted, duplicates, errors} summary
sends POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/runs/:run_id/postmortem with a JSON body containing run_status, started_at, completed_at, task_summary, cost_summary, and optional fields
routes the request to the postmortem handler after applying auth middleware
validates the credential and resolves workspace access
validates run_id, validates run_status against the four accepted values, validates task_summary and cost_summary sub-schemas, checks schema_version (rejects with HTTP 422 if not 1)
executes INSERT OR IGNORE into postmortems using run_id as the primary key
returns HTTP 201 with {run_id, run_status, created_at} or HTTP 200 if duplicate

execution_paths.title: Operator queries audit events with pagination

steps.action: sends GET /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/runs/:run_id/events?limit=50&order=desc&since=2026-09-01T00:00:00Z
routes the request to the events query handler after applying auth middleware
validates the credential (PAT with audit:read scope or API key) and resolves workspace read access
validates run_id, parses filter parameters (since, until, event_type, severity, node_id, order, limit, cursor)
executes a SELECT query on agent_audit_events with WHERE clauses for run_id and filters, ORDER BY timestamp DESC, LIMIT 51 (limit+1 to detect has_more)
encodes the cursor from the last returned record's timestamp and id as base64 JSON, sets has_more based on whether limit+1 records were returned
returns HTTP 200 with {events: [...], next_cursor: string|null, has_more: boolean}
starts the af-hub binary
resolves the DuckDB path from AF_AUDIT_DB_PATH or derives it as <data_dir>/audit.duckdb from config.toml database.path
calls os.MkdirAll on the parent directory of the resolved path, then opens the DuckDB connection via the duckdb-go driver
executes all nine CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS statements and any ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS migrations in a single transaction
creates audit.NewStore(auditDB), audit.NewEmitter(store), calls audit.RegisterRoutes(api, store, emitter), and collects audit.Permissions() into extraPerms
begins serving HTTP requests on all registered routes including the 14 audit endpoints

execution_paths.title: Workspace-scoped PAT rejected for mismatched workspace

steps.action: sends POST /api/v1/workspaces/workspace-A/runs/20260901_120000_a1b2c3/events with a PAT scoped to workspace-B
routes the request to the audit events handler
detects that the PAT's workspace scope (workspace-B) does not match the URL :slug (workspace-A)
returns HTTP 403 with apikit error body of type workspace_mismatch

symbols.name: Driver
symbols.signature: database/sql-compatible driver registered under the name "duckdb"
symbols.notes: Requires CGO_ENABLED=1 at build time. DSN is always a file path (e.g., /data/audit.duckdb). Use sql.Open("duckdb", path) to open a connection. Tests must use t.TempDir() for isolation — :memory: is NOT used because it does not exercise the file-locking and MkdirAll paths.
